name: Q-Bot underfloor insulation robot
specialisedFor: underfloor insulation: spraying foam under suspended timber and concrete floors
summary: A small remote-controlled wheeled robot that goes through a small opening into the void under a suspended timber or concrete floor and sprays polyurethane foam insulation onto the underside of the floor.

germany.statusNote: Not sold as a machine. Q-Bot installs underfloor insulation itself in the UK and rents its robots for a monthly fee per robot to trained installation partners; partners are in the UK and France, and the partner page also invites partners in the Netherlands. No German partner, customer or office found.

specs.label: Minimum void height
specs.conditions: clearance below the bottom of the joists; UK Building Regulations also require 150 mm to remain under the insulation

specs.label: Void height (high-void robot)
specs.conditions: 2022 interview: a high-void robot for 30-100 cm and a smaller robot for voids down to 20 cm

specs.label: Drive
specs.value: four independently controlled drive wheels with suspension

specs.label: Control
specs.value: remote, by gamepad, with video feed and sensors
specs.conditions: the robot builds a 3D map of the void for the operator

specs.label: Insulation sprayed
specs.value: closed-cell polyurethane spray foam (KIWA BDA Agrément-certified, HFO-blown)
specs.conditions: the 2022 interview also mentions open-cell foam

notes: Remote-controlled, not autonomous: an operator outside the void drives the robot and sprays with a gamepad, using the camera image and a 3D map; preset spray patterns can be chosen (2022 interview).
Pulls a supply hose from a rig or van into position; drives over rubble, and according to the 2022 interview through sand and mud.
Needs at least 200 mm clearance below the joists.
Goes in through a small hatch in the floor or an opening in an outside wall.

images.alt: Three Q-Bot underfloor insulation robots with large off-road wheels on a wooden floor

evidence.task: Sprayed underfloor insulation in more than 5,500 homes, over 100,000 m² of suspended floors
evidence.where: Homes in the UK, Q-Bot's own installation service
evidence.note: Cumulative since 2012, as stated on the maker's site; installs are done by robot or by hand.

Demonstrator robot from an EU-funded project insulated floors in 120 homes
evidence.where: Homes in the UK and France
